Gina, saw Softeon come together with IFS and land across Levels 1 to 5 in the 2026 Gartner Critical Capabilities.

An acquisition and fresh analyst recognition usually mean more in-market accounts in play than BD can personally cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Softeon off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Gina, quick follow-up for Softeon.

With the IFS combination opening accounts, the question is how many meetings BD needs to book to keep pipeline ahead of target, and most teams find the gap late, then scramble the quarter. More reps alone rarely closes it in time.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Softeon needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.

Gina, last bit of proof for Softeon.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Softeon's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Gina, I will stop reaching out here, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not the priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters during an acquisition, and I know folding two teams together is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Softeon either way.
